value: Puzzle-game programmer (Bean and Nothingness) — open to collaboration

I co-created Bean and Nothingness, a logic puzzle game that shipped on Steam in 2021 and sits at 98% positive across 216 reviews. I was co-lead programmer on it — C++/SDL/OpenGL, including the replay/undo system and a GUI level editor we shipped through Steam Workshop — and lead puzzle designer, writing 100+ of its puzzles and editing all ~200. I also did all music and sound design.

I am reaching out because {{WHY THIS STUDIO — one specific, honest sentence about their game}}. If you are looking for another pair of hands on puzzle logic, tools, or engine work, I would be happy to talk. I am also happy to just trade notes on puzzle design.
